j.dv.ab.html: יִשַׁי 41 n.pr.m. father of David

j.dx.aa.html:
[יָשֵׁן] vb. sleep
Qal sleep, go to sleep, and be sleep
Niph. only in deriv. sense of become inactive or stationary
Pi. causat. she made him sleep

j.dx.ac.html: יָשֵׁן n.pr.m. one of David’s heroes

j.dy.aa.html:
[יָשַׁע] vb. Hiph. deliver; Niph. intrans. and pass.
Niph.
1 be liberated, saved (prop. placed in freedom)
2 be saved in battle, victorious
Hiph.
1 deliver, save (prop. give width and breadth to, liberate)
2 save from moral troubles
3 give victory to

j.dy.ab.html:
יֵ֫שַׁע n.m. deliverance, rescue, salvation, also safety, welfare
1 safety, welfare, prosperity
2 salvation, i.e. primarily physical rescue, by God, oft. with added spiritual idea
3 victory

j.dy.ac.html:
יְשׁוּעָה n.f. salvation
1 welfare, prosperity
2 deliverance
3 salvation by God, primarily from external evils, but often with added spiritual idea
4 victory

j.dy.ae.html: שׁוּעַ n.pr.m. father of Judah’s wife

j.dy.ah.html:
יִשְׁעִי n.pr.m. (salutary)
1 one of the line of Jerahmeel
2 a chief of Manasseh
3 a chief of Judah
4 a chief of Simeon

j.dy.ai.html:
יְשַׁעְיָ֫הוּ n.pr.m. (salvation of Yah)
1 Isaiah, son of ’Amôṣ, the prophet
2 one of the children of Jeduthun
3 a Levite ancestor of one of David's treasurers

j.dy.aj.html:
יְשַׁעְיָה n.pr.m. (salvation of Yah)
1 grandson of Zerubbabel
2 chief of the sons of Elam, who went up with Ezra
3 chief of sons of Merari in time of Ezra
4 a Benjamite

j.dy.ak.html:
הוֹשֵׁעַ n.pr.m. (salvation)
1 orig. name of Joshua
2 last king of Israel
3 the prophet Hosea
4 an Ephraimite chief under David
5 a chief under Nehemiah

j.dy.al.html:
הוֹשַׁעֲיָה n.pr.m. (Yah has saved)
1 a prince of Judah
2 father of Azariah or Jezaniah, a chief in time of Jeremiah

j.dy.an.html: [מוֹשָׁעָה] n.f. only pl. saving acts ψ 68:21.

j.dz.aa.html:
יָשַׁר vb. be smooth, straight, right
Qal
1 go straight
2 fig., be pleasing, agreeable, right
3 in ethical sense, straightforward, upright
Pi.
1 make smooth, straight
2 lead straight along, direct
3 esteem right, approve
Pu. gold made level, laid smoothly out, upon the graven work
Hiph. let thine eyelids look straight before thee

j.dz.ab.html:
יָשָׁר adj. straight, right
1 straight, level
2 right, pleasing
3 straightforward, just, upright
4 abstr., uprightness

j.dz.ac.html:
יֹ֫שֶׁר n.m. straightness, uprightness
1 straightness, evenness, of paths
2 rightness, uprightness
3 what is due, right

j.dz.ad.html: יֶ֫שֶׁר n.pr.m. (uprightness) son of Caleb 1 Ch 2:18

j.dz.ae.html: [יְשָׁרָה] n.f. uprightness;—1 K 3:6

j.dz.af.html: יְשֻׁרוּן n.pr.m. (upright one); poetic name of Israel, designating it under its ideal character

j.dz.ai.html:
שָׁרוֹן n.pr.loc. Sharon
1 (with art.), name of maritime plain on Mediterr., fr, Joppa northward, noted for fertility
2 region E. of Jordan

j.eb.aa.html: יתד (√ of foll.; mng. dub.; Ar. Arabic, drive in peg, be firm (of peg), is appar. denom.)

j.ee.ab.html: אֵיתָן, אֵתָן adj. perennial, ever-flowing, fig. permanent, as subst, steady flow, permanence

j.ee.ae.html: יִתְנָ֑ן n.pr.loc. (etym. dub.) city in the Negeb of Judah Jos 15:23

c save over, i.e. presevre alive
